course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Selection and parameters
goal: Verify a typed customer filter and half-open hour boundary using two own requests.

prerequisites.text: onec.p6; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: A query expresses a set
paragraphs: 1C query language addresses the metadata model, not arbitrary SQL for modifying internal tables. SELECT chooses fields, FROM defines the source, andWHERE defines conditions. Begin with expected identities and values rather than selecting everything and hoping to understand later.

Preparation creates an own customer/service and 30/45 requests at 12:00/13:00 on November 2. Record their actual references. A growing infobase need not contain only two documents: the own reference defines the set; names are not keys.

sections.title: Reconcile the complete experiment
paragraphs: 12:00 belongs to this interval;13:00 to the next. The own reference excludes earlier work.

code.output: ГраницаВерна=True and ПустойКлюч=True: first request/30, then no rows.

sections.title: Pass values as parameters
paragraphs: Do not concatenate customer names or dates into query text. SetParameter supplies a typed value separately from structure. A customer reference is not its display string. A parameter cannot stand in for an arbitrary field name: choose structure from an allowlist and keep user values parameterized.

Pass a CatalogRef.Клиенты and two full date/time values.12:00 is included and 13:00 excluded. An empty reference of the same type is a separate negative input expected to return no rows; never concatenate a name or operator text.

sections.title: Periods have precise boundaries
paragraphs: UseDate>=Start ANDDate<End for an agreed half-open interval. IncludeStart and excludeEnd. A daily query must account for document time. Ordinary rows do not expose a last-second error; add records exactly on both boundaries.

A document exactly at the upper boundary distinguishes < from <=: the latter returns two rows/75 instead of one/30. Without boundary data both versions might agree. Verify the actual first-document reference as well as the total.

sections.title: A case that distinguishes the wrong solution
paragraphs: The code compiles; membership and total distinguish the semantic defect.

code.source: In another own copy replace З.Дата < &Конец with З.Дата <= &Конец.
code.output: ГраницаВерна=False: two rows/75 rather than one/30.

sections.title: Result and cursor differ
paragraphs: Execute returns a query result; Select creates traversal; Unload materializes a value table. Choose by volume and needed operations. An empty result is not inherently an error. Reconcile identities, types, count and sum, then verify reading did not modify documents.

Two independent results check the one correct row/30 and the empty-key case. Reading changes no documents. Retain definitions and data but remove the startup call. Define a new expectation before changing the interval.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A customer name replaces its reference. Use the actual typed reference of the experiment, not its display label.
An equal sum is accepted without membership checks. Reconcile actual keys and row count before accepting the aggregate.
A tiny timing is promoted to a server performance guarantee. Retain raw observations and explicitly limit the environment and metric.

selfcheck.feedback: A parameter preserves reference type and separates values from structure.

practice.title: Selection and parameters
practice.task: Add a row one second before the interval and prove it is excluded.
practice.environment: Separate own synthetic infobase; retain the prior module and its backup. Studio and Sandbox optional.

steps.title: Preserve the starting state
steps.action: Close Enterprise. Export a DT backup from Administration → Dump infobase; restore it into a new empty directory and verify the actual path. Preserve earlier functions/fields.
steps.expected: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.
steps.troubleshooting: A new list name alone does not create another database directory.
steps.before: Own path, prior sources and a restorable backup identified.

steps.title: Add the complete server source
steps.action: Create a server/server-call module without Global or Privileged. Paste the complete source below outside other procedures; retain a single shared preparation function if already present.
steps.why: Database access has an explicit server boundary.
steps.expected: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not paste definitions inside startup or into an arbitrary Studio file.
steps.before: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.

steps.title: Prepare and call the experiment
steps.why: Print every named result instead of accepting compilation alone.
steps.expected: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.
steps.troubleshooting: Keep one startup handler; ensure the common module is server-call enabled.
steps.before: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.

steps.title: Save, update and run once
steps.action: Run once, record both actual boolean claims and, for measurement, the two durations. Keep the created keys.
steps.why: Observe actual 1C data, not the browser diagram.
steps.expected: ГраницаВерна=True and ПустойКлюч=True: first request/30, then no rows.
steps.troubleshooting: Record the first failed assertion and module/line. Do not change the expectation merely to get True.
steps.before: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.

steps.title: Retain both results
steps.action: Remove only the startup call. Retain functions/data and investigate the negative control in another restored copy.
steps.why: Preserve provenance and avoid repeating data creation at every startup.
steps.expected: Original retained, negative experiment isolated, automatic caller removed.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not clear registers or delete old documents to make a total agree.
steps.before: ГраницаВерна=True and ПустойКлюч=True: first request/30, then no rows.
